nodes.label: FluentBit
nodes.description: FluentBit DaemonSet that tails Quarkus Flow log files and performs batch INSERT into PostgreSQL raw tables

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Raw Tables
nodes.description: PostgreSQL raw event storage layer containing JSONB event data with tag and timestamp

nodes.label: workflow_events_raw
nodes.description: Raw workflow events table storing unprocessed workflow lifecycle events with tag, time, and JSONB data columns
nodes.source_location: left table in raw tables layer (coordinates: x=130, y=160)

nodes.label: task_events_raw
nodes.description: Raw task events table storing unprocessed task execution events with tag, time, and JSONB data columns
nodes.source_location: right table in raw tables layer (coordinates: x=470, y=160)

nodes.label: BEFORE INSERT Trigger
nodes.description: PostgreSQL database trigger that fires before INSERT on raw tables, extracting JSONB fields and performing UPSERT to normalized tables with sub-millisecond latency

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Normalized Tables
nodes.description: PostgreSQL normalized storage layer containing structured workflow and task data extracted from raw events

nodes.label: workflow_instances
nodes.description: Normalized workflow instances table storing structured workflow data including id, name, version, status, start/end times, input/output, and error information
nodes.source_location: left table in normalized layer (coordinates: x=130, y=350)

properties.schema: id, name, version, status, start, end, input, output, error (type, title, detail)

nodes.label: task_instances
nodes.description: Normalized task instances table storing structured task execution data including id, workflow_id, name, status, start/end times, input/output, and error information
nodes.source_location: right table in normalized layer (coordinates: x=470, y=350)

properties.schema: id, workflow_id, name, status, start, end, input, output, error (type, title, detail)

nodes.label: GraphQL API
nodes.description: SmallRye GraphQL API that exposes workflow and task data for querying, using JPA/Hibernate to access normalized PostgreSQL tables
